title: 経営情報専門実験・演習A
subtitle: Management Systems Major Lab/Exercises A
keywords: Business plan 2.Social impact 3.Balanced Scorecard 4.Non financial indicator 5.Metrics
educationalGoal: This course is aimed at improving "business application / project execution ability", which is the learning / educational goal of the Department of Management Information. Deepen understanding of the knowledge and skills of (1) finance and (2) management (SDGs and data analysis) of specialized subjects, using activities devised in PD practice as the theme.
advice: 1) Business (financial) planning exercise Exercises to study and create business (financial) plans for activities devised in PD practice. In the exercise, the necessary data will be the primary data acquired during PD practice and the secondary data in desktop research, and active learning will be made by effectively utilizing the related learned knowledge and skills. Therefore, it is required to thoroughly review the already-learned subjects shown in the lesson details before attending the lesson. 2) Balanced Scorecard planning exercise Exercise to study and create Balanced Scorecard as tools to manage both financial and non financial performance.
requiredKnowledge: In business (financial) planning exercises, basic knowledge and skills to collect and analyze data from the Internet, newspapers, publications, etc., and basic knowledge and skills to create a financial plan are required.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand and explain the elements of financial management necessary for creating a financial plan.
Be able to formulate a financial plan that is consistent with social impact
Be able to make both financial goal and non financial goal in their strategy
Be able to make a story between several goals
Set proper metrics to achieve goals logically.
Be able to explain how to increase financial and social impact
